features.name: Driving Force Register & Lifecycle Initiator

features.name: Time Horizon Assessment (Stage 2)

features.name: Rating of Urgency & Impact/Uncertainty Evaluation (Stage 3)

features.name: Status & Action Assignment (Stage 4)
